importSource.note: ADR-037 converter v0.14.0 corpus (wave-20): the stem-figure tranche closes the wave-15 backlog - all 48 figures/tables the restored question stems reference are now eyeballed crops (chromatograms, apparatus, structure diagrams, mini periodic table, pie chart, displayed-formula letter runs, interleaved property tables; the rasterized 2019-06 p12 structures via pixel profiling), rendered deterministically through the F45 manual-crop branch from STEM-RESTORE.json stemFigures specs (F57). Exporter v6 (F-W20-1): stem figures inline INSIDE the stem block (prose -> figure -> part text); part-targeted figures (2019-06 2C bond-energy tables for 5(a)(i)) render on the part that reads them; stemFigureRef inlines 2 already-served figures; F-W20-2 cuts the flattened figure-label soup from the served stems (dropSpan x2, dropTail x44, anchors verbatim fail-closed). 1 tranche flag retired with evidence (2023-11 1C Q7 has no displayed formulae). Part C (F60): 124 authored worked answers (all of 2019-06 1C + 2020-01 1C) served as solutionMd from SOLUTION-ENRICH.json with the build-time value-fidelity review pass - the MS cells and mark points stay verbatim. Corpus: 30/54 slices changed, 48 crop assets, every other extraction field byte-identical; 68 canaries (C66 corpus-wide bidirectional ledger check + C67-C70 pins). Wave-15 UX doctrine governs: best learner experience, values never invented. Group-stem restore and the solution-enrichment wave are the next tranches. 54 official sets (16x1C + 16x2C + R-variants), 477 questions, 2607 parts, all spec-tagged.
